about: A mark was made on lines `start`..`end` (1-based, inclusive) of the file `original`; its hash is the hash of those lines. `current` is the same side of the file now, or null if that side does not exist or is not text. `expected` is where the marked lines are now: [start, end], or null if they cannot be placed. Same place first; else exactly one window with the same hash; else null.

cases.name: lines that moved are found when they occur once
a multi-line mark found earlier in the file
a mark that ran past the end of the shorter file is gone
a side that no longer exists resolves to nothing
a repeated window is ambiguous, not guessed (the blank line now occurs at 3 and 5)
the original position wins even if the text repeats elsewhere
a multi-line window still at its place wins over a copy of it
a multi-line window that moved and now occurs twice is ambiguous
